sources.snippet: sae-qwen2.5-1.5b-instruct-topk-l14 A TopK sparse autoencoder for Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, residual-stream layer 14 (d_in=1536, d_sae=24576, k=64, FVU=0.2908). Trained with the v2 recipe (BOS-drop + per-dim standardization) for The Refusal Slope: A Mechanistic Taxonomy of Feature Fate in Quantized Edge Intelligence (M. Elrashid, BUiD).
